headline: TSLA closes near $373 — stock off ~4% on Apr 30, down ~15% YTD after Q1 beat-on-profit / miss-on-revenue; JPMorgan reiterates $145 Sell (60% downside); widest mega-cap analyst spread on Wall Street: $125 bear vs $600 bull, $420 average

Musk on Q1 call: deliberate slow ramp of unsupervised FSD — 'It wouldn't be right for us to go to very large-scale unsupervised FSD when we know that there are software improvements in the pipeline that would improve safety'; signals conservative commercial pace despite Austin fleet live
source: Yahoo Finance / Motley Fool (Q1 2026 Earnings Call)

headline: Post-Q1 bear case crystallizes: HW3 vehicles (~40% of installed fleet) cannot run unsupervised FSD without costly Terafab retrofits; $25B+ capex guided for 2026; Motley Fool and EVShift frame TSLA as 'Hold' — platform potential real but revenue from robotaxi/Optimus remains immaterial in 2026

Electrek confirms Tesla unsupervised robotaxi fleet reaches 25 vehicles across Texas — 'finally shows signs of ramping'; Austin 19, Dallas 3, Houston 3; +47% growth in 8 days; fastest weekly expansion since multi-city launch; still pre-commercial scale but trajectory inflecting positively

First Tesla Semi rolls off high-volume production line at Gigafactory Nevada — milestone for long-delayed Class 8 electric truck program; Reuters, Electrek, electrive.com all confirm image of first production-spec unit with workforce on the new line; full volume ramp targeted before June 30, 2026

Tesla Autonomy Pop-Up opens TODAY at F1 Miami Grand Prix — Cybercab and Optimus on display at Lummus Park Fan Fest through May 3; highest-visibility public showcase of Tesla's autonomous stack yet, timed to F1 Crypto.com race weekend crowds

Musk: Optimus V3 is 'Special' — deliberate reveal delay to block competitor copying; Gen 3 on track for public unveiling later in 2026; Fremont factory retooling for Optimus production begins in early May

Ross Gerber: Tesla + SpaceX merger would create 'Berkshire Hathaway of AI' — TSLA slips in premarket as speculation intensifies ahead of potential SpaceX IPO and H1 2027 merger timeline flagged by Wedbush

Tesla 2026.14.3 Spring Update hits 3rd wave rollout — Hey Grok voice AI, FSD app redesign, 24hr Dashcam, and Cyberhog Pet Mode now reaching broader fleet; Grok can now 'see' saved location labels for natural language nav
Tesla AI5 chip design finalized in April 2026 — next-generation inference processor completed at Tesla's Research Fab at Giga Texas; will power future FSD + Optimus workloads; successor to HW4/AI4+
